newsitem.title: USA: Criticare Systems to focus on Q4 activity.
newsitem.headline: Criticare Systems to focus on Q4 activity.

text.p: Criticare Systems Inc, which on Friday reported a higher loss in the third quarter, said its corporate focus is on the fourth quarter, when it has its first chance to profit from a corporate product redesign.

Criticare earlier said it posted a loss of $284,678, or $0.04 a share, versus a loss of $217,682, or $0.03, in the period ended March 31. Sales fell to $5.5 million from $7.7 million a year ago, the company said.

Criticare said factors that will affect fourth-quarter results include its rising order backlog, a $400,000 order from mainland China that has already been booked, a remote monitoring product that is expected to ship and the first of several new products will be available for sale.
Criticare designs and makes patient monitoring systems and non-invasive sensors for the health care industry.
Its shares closed off 5/32 Friday at 5.
